threat_event: CUI drawings in the commercial project collaboration SaaS are breached or found by DoD
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: SYS-C1 is not FedRAMP Moderate equivalent
treatment_plan: Finish migration to SYS-C2; block CUI in SYS-C1 (POAM-019)

threat_event: The division cannot bid DoD work after 2026-11-10 because it lacks CMMC Level 2 (C3PAO)
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: SPRS score 71 of 110; a conditional status needs at least 88
treatment_plan: Close point gaps; C3PAO assessment by 2027-03-31; bid as teaming partner until then

threat_event: Subcontractors receive CUI without the 7012 flow-down and do not report their incidents
treatment_plan: Amend active subcontracts; share CUI only through SYS-C2

threat_event: The CMMC system security plan ignores inherited group controls, and the assessor finds gaps
The 72-hour DoD report is missed after an incident
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No CUI steps in group playbooks; no medium assurance certificate held by the SOC
existing_controls: CUI program manager holds a certificate
treatment_plan: CUI steps in playbooks; backup certificate holders (POAM-005)

threat_event: Commissioning hands over buildings with default passwords and undocumented remote access
treatment_plan: Turnover checklist: credentials, remote access, program copies to the repository

threat_event: Security drawings of public buildings leak from jobsite plan rooms or subcontractors
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Plan rooms not always locked; drawings emailed to subcontractors
treatment_plan: Locked plan rooms; CUI marking; SYS-C2 only for CUI (POAM-021)

threat_event: Ransomware halts project collaboration or estimating
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: SaaS dependence; local file shares at 14 regional offices
treatment_plan: Retire regional file shares; offline drawing sets

threat_event: Business email compromise diverts a subcontractor payment
treatment_plan: Payment portal with verified bank changes

threat_event: Subcontractors install covered cameras on federal jobsites
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Section 889 clause flowed down, but no product check
treatment_plan: Product submittal check against the approved list

threat_event: A jobsite network is compromised through telematics or cameras
The estimating AI service retains CUI drawings
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: CUI uploaded before the block of 2026-09-01
treatment_plan: Confirm deletion; approved alternative inside SYS-C2 (P10 AI-006)

threat_event: Bid data is stolen by an insider
Departed project staff keep access to SYS-C1
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Guest accounts for agency staff and subcontractors

threat_event: Certified payroll data with personal information is exposed
A laptop with project data is lost
A hurricane destroys jobsite trailers and paper records
treatment_plan: Accepted: SaaS records cover the loss

threat_event: The SPRS score overstates the division's implementation, creating liability for a false representation
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Self-assessment did not test inherited controls or the commissioning workspace
treatment_plan: Independent re-assessment by group internal audit; corrected SPRS posting
